name: Sanjivani Farm & Resort
description: 16-acre eco-luxury farm stay and nature retreat in Palghar near Mumbai. Features wooden cottages, private boating, organic dining, and family activities. Explore cottages at /cottages; live reservations and dynamic pricing managed via Doorloom.

bookingEngine.description: Third-party booking and reservations engine managed directly by the resort owner. All room rates, calendar availability, seasonal discounts, and instant reservations are live on Doorloom.

entries.name: Resort Cottages & Stays
entries.description: Explore Sanjivani Farm's scenic nature cottages — Wooden Glass Cottage, Red Stone Cottage, and Family Dormitory. Features video tours, photo galleries, amenities, and direct Doorloom booking.

entries.name: Wooden Glass Cottage
entries.description: Eco-luxury wooden glass cottage with panoramic nature views, AC, and private balcony. Capacity: 2-8 guests. Explore at /cottages and book live on Doorloom.

entries.name: Red Stone Cottage
entries.description: Rustic stone luxury cottage with veranda, AC, and lush lawn access. Capacity: 3-10 guests. Explore at /cottages and book live on Doorloom.

entries.name: Family Dormitory Cottage
entries.description: Spacious group hall with 2 attached bathrooms, AC, lake & river views for large families and retreats. Capacity: 8-16 guests. Explore at /cottages and book live on Doorloom.

entries.name: Farm-to-Table Organic Dining
entries.description: Authentic Konkan and Maharashtrian pure vegetarian & non-vegetarian farm-to-table cuisine prepared with estate-grown produce.

entries.name: Farm Recreation & Adventure Activities
entries.description: Private lake boating, kayaking, swimming pool with rain dance, Sanjivani toy train, hammock garden, and cycling trails.
